caption:
Heart gone numb to other people's pain? One small touch can wake it. (Amos 6:6 devotional)

The core sin wasn't the feast — it was hearts unmoved by another's affliction. One small touch is enough to begin.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Whose pain have I stopped letting reach me?
